item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00479","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C16","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C18 is a clear reusable drafting template: it is an earlier Eisenhower memorandum to executive departments and agencies directing their participation in a specified civil-defense exercise, with the same motivational discussion followed by a government-wide participation command. The child adapts that structure from a Washington-area exercise to a nationwide exercise and adds employee-release machinery expressly drawn from the April 22, 1954 order in C16. C03 provides broader civil-defense planning background but is less directly reflected in the memorandum's drafting.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"To the Heads of all Departments and Agencies","parent_excerpt":"To the Heads of Executive Departments and Agencies","explanation":"Nearly identical memorandum addressee."},{"child_excerpt":"The task of civil defense is vital to our national life. It demands preparedness","parent_excerpt":"The need for effective civil defense planning is still vital to our national welfare. But national plans and preparations are of little value without active participation","explanation":"Parallel rationale emphasizing the vital importance of civil defense, preparedness, and active participation."},{"child_excerpt":"Therefore, I hereby direct each department and agency of the Executive Branch of the Government ... to take part in this civil defense exercise","parent_excerpt":"Accordingly, it is directed that each Department and Agency of the Executive Branch of the Federal Government ... participate in the Civil Defense Exercise","explanation":"Distinctively close operative command with the same transition, institutional scope, and required participation in a scheduled civil-defense exercise."},{"child_excerpt":"to authorize the release of Federal employees who are enrolled in local civil defense organizations to perform such civil defense duties as are assigned during this exercise","parent_excerpt":"may ... authorize such of the said personnel ... to participate in pre-emergency training programs and test exercises in cooperation with any State or political sub-division thereof","explanation":"This added component tracks C16's specific machinery for agency authorization of federal employees participating in state or local civil-defense exercises."}]}
